source: William Lilly Christian Astrology original 1647, Wellcome b30338724
heading: The second House of RICHES, or the Goods of FORTUNE
source_character: Selectively anchored original 1647 text paraphrases, not complete diplomatic transcription, not human forecast validation.

source_groups.source_group: Unnumbered House of Riches and four-part source list

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: The second House of RICHES, or the Goods of FORTUNE
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The wealthy-estate section starts after an ornamental separator on original PDF586/printed552 without any Roman chapter numeral.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: In every Nativity you are to consider these Significators
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Lilly frames the subsequent factors as a required consideration in every nativity; this is a historical directive, not a human validation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: the cusp or beginning of the second house
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: First source factor is the second house beginning/cusp, not a planet or sign selected after seeing financial outcomes.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: from five degrees before the cusp thereof
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The stated lower influence boundary begins five degrees preceding the second cusp, but the original house/degree computation is not supplied here.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: untill within five degrees of the cusp of the third
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The source's other boundary is phrased as 'within five degrees of' the third cusp; avoid silently choosing an unverified exclusive or inclusive mathematical operator.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: the Lord of that house, and how dignified
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The second house ruler and its essential/accidental dignity are another factor distinct from the geometric extent of the house.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: the Lord of the Signe intercepted (if any be so)
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The ruler of an intercepted zodiac sign is considered only if an intercepted sign exists in the second; optional, not always present.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Part of Fortune and his Lord
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The Part of Fortune and its dispositor are separately named as wealth significators, subject to original 1647 arithmetic.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: and Jupiter, a generall Significator of Wealth
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Jupiter is given an additional general wealth-significator role, separate from second-house ownership or Part of Fortune.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: those Planets ... casually in the second
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Planets actually occupying the second house are included in the author's fourth source category.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: nearer a Planet is to the cusp of the second
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The nearer an occupant planet is to the second cusp, the stronger/more apparent its alleged signification; source supplies no continuous weighting formula.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: PTOLOMEY did onely give these directions
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Lilly explicitly attributes the immediately discussed causal/origin wealth rules to Ptolemy; the source is secondary testimony about an earlier author.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: from whom, or by what causes ... attaine an Estate
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The attributed Ptolemaic scope is origin or agent of acquiring an estate, not every contemporary financial outcome.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: lib. 4. cap. 1
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Lilly supplies a book/chapter locator for his Ptolemaic material; check against Ptolemy independently before treating it as exact quotation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Planets having dominion of the Signe wherein Part of Fortune is
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: As attributed to Ptolemy, planets governing the zodiac sign of Part of Fortune are wealth-origin significators.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: what familiarity or aspect they have unto Part Fortune
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: These governors' aspects/familiarities to Part of Fortune are separate conditions rather than an unconditional sign-based outcome.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent aspects of the Planets unto those Planets and Part Fortune
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Supportive aspects to the Part of Fortune and its governing planets are alleged to alter wealth, under the attributed system.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: also the Planets who are elevated above them
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The relative elevation of other planets is included as a separate consideration; exact geometry is not mathematically defined here.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: either of the same or contrary quality
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Planets higher than the wealth governors may be harmonious or contrary in quality, and the distinction must be preserved.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: when those who govern Part of Fortune are very strong
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Strong governance of Part of Fortune is attributed to great increases in wealth, an unmeasured and unvalidated forecast.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: especially if assisted by Sun or Moon
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The Sun or Moon allegedly reinforces the previous condition, not a guarantee of wealth from lunar/solar placement alone.

source_groups.source_group: Five planetary routes to wealth with Ptolemaic attribution

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn Enriches by Buildings, Navigation, Husbandry
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Saturn is historically linked to building, maritime navigation and agriculture as channels for attaining wealth.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter by Fidelity or Truth, Government, Priest-hood ... Religion
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Jupiter is linked to trustworthiness, government and religious roles as alleged channels of wealth.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars by Warre and conduct of Armies
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Mars is linked to war or military command as the alleged mechanism for estate acquisition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Venus by Friends and gifts of Women
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Venus is linked with friends or gifts from women, a historical gender stereotype and not a financial recommendation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury by Oratory, Merchandizing
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Mercury is linked to oratory and trade/commerce as alleged pathways for acquiring wealth.

source_groups.source_group: Inheritance from Saturn–Jupiter and associated lunar conditions

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: When Saturn governeth Part of Fortune
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The source begins an inheritance conditional with Saturn governing the Part of Fortune; the condition is not Saturn anywhere in the chart.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter casting his good aspect thereunto
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: A favorable Jupiter aspect to Fortune in that configuration is alleged to imply inherited estate.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: principally when the aspect is in superior Angles
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The alleged inheritance result is emphasized under superior-angle geometry, with no defined numerical effect size.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Jupiter in a Bycorporeall Signe
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Jupiter in a bicorporeal sign is a separate condition in the inheritance discussion; its operator scope with the following clauses may be ambiguous.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in the West angle, and in a good aspect with the Moon
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The western-angle and favorable lunar-aspect description qualifies the alternate source inheritance route.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or she afflicting
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The original 'or she afflicting' wording has an unclear lunar pronoun/operator referent; preserve ambiguity, do not silently turn it into confirmation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: the Native ... adopted child ... Heir of another man's Goods
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The historical author asserts a third-party inheritance/adoption pathway; source does not establish an independently verified outcome.

source_groups.source_group: Wealth retention versus damage and general timing

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Wealth shall continue, if Planets of the same nature doe joyne
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The source alleges wealth persists when planets of the same nature join the Part of Fortune governors as significators.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: those Planets who dispose Part of Fortune
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The continuation judgment is conditioned on connection to actual dispositor planets, not any arbitrary natal planet.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Maleficall Planets have principall dominion in those places
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: A contrary historical rule alleges destruction of estate when malefics chiefly dominate those significator places.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or are ascending unto them
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Malefic planets ascending toward the key places form another potential adverse condition; original timing/geometry is not fully specified here.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: The time when, universally is taken by the accesse
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The source assigns wealth-event timing to planetary access rather than only static wealth-house descriptions.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: of the Planets to the angles and succedant places
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The author's original timing targets are angles and succedent houses, which require an explicit computational definition for testing.

source_groups.source_group: Source-authority distinction and following numbered chapter

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Thus Ptolomey
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Lilly explicitly ends the cited Ptolemaic wealth-origin discussion here, bounding the attributed authority.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Leovitius ... much refined the judgments belonging to this house
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Lilly credits Leovitius with refining second-house rules beyond Ptolemy; independent source proof remains to be checked.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Ptolomey ... in all his writings was extreame short
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: The author explicitly contrasts Ptolemy's brevity with later amplifications, indicating different bodies of source authority.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: I follow Leovitius and Origanus
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Lilly identifies Leovitius and Origanus as the subsequent interpretive authorities, rather than the unnumbered passage being all Ptolemy.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXIIII Whether the Native shall be Rich
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: A separate numbered chapter starts below a horizontal divider on original PDF587; its content must be extracted separately.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: If all the Significators be constituted so
claims.source_meaning_historical_only: Only the incipit of that next numbered chapter is witnessed here, and is not a wealth-introduction rule.
